name: feedback-panel
description: Bulk feedback from Daniel on long lists: Claude writes items as JSON, feedback-panel serves a local tick-box page (search, filters, per-item notes, Claude's suggestion tags, autosave, Submit), Claude reads the ticks back, acts on them and writes per-item outcomes the page shows. For reviews too big for a terminal multiple-choice question: packages to remove, plugins, repos, files, skills, MCP servers.
